audit.why: 51% over 798 games. Pantheon owns 1-5, level 6 is Riftwalk's first breath, and 2+ items is Kassadin's. The written arc already matches, and the mirror audit at audits/top/kassadin__pantheon.json reached the same shape from his side.

Spikes are placed right: your levels 1-3, his level 6 Riftwalk, then Rod of Ages and Lich Bane. win[6] already reads Kassadin, which matches the mirror where win[6] and phases[6].side were both flipped to Kassadin. Do not move that cell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Null Sphere with a silence in four places, and credits Void Stone with a magic shield that eats your empowered Comet Spear in three more.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere text is 'dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield' — damage, a channel interrupt, and a shield on Kassadin. No silence. And Void Stone is 'takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision' — flat magic damage reduction, not a shield. Comet Spear and Shield Vault are physical, so Void Stone does not touch your combo at all. The page tells you to fear two effects that cannot happen to you.
audit.corrected: Null Sphere restated as damage plus a self-shield; the Void Stone claim removed and replaced with the interaction that does decide the matchup — Riftwalk's 500 range getting behind Aegis Assault, which is only invulnerable from the front.

audit.why: Aegis Assault is 22/21/20/19/18s — the longest non-ultimate cooldown in either kit and the thing Kassadin plays around. Riftwalk falls to 5/3.5/2s, so 'catch him mid-blink' has a shelf life. Force Pulse is 21s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into mid and the late text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault's directional limit is never stated on your own page.
audit.why: You are the one holding the shield. Knowing it only covers the front is what stops you from raising it and then chasing him through his own blink.
audit.corrected: Stated in mid and in the late-game text.

edits.after: Once Kassadin stacks Rod of Ages and Lich Bane, Riftwalk falls toward a 2s cooldown and he blinks behind Aegis Assault, invulnerable from the front only, then bursts you.

edits.before: Use his passive magic shield and Q silence to absorb your empowered Q and shut off your combo

edits.after: Face Aegis Assault at his Null Sphere poke, then Shield Vault in while Riftwalk is unlearned

edits.before: With all three basics up you W-stun in, empowered Q, and E through his silence Q for your premier kill window before his shield scales.
edits.after: All three basics up: Shield Vault in, empowered Comet Spear, Aegis Assault faced at Null Sphere — premier kill window, and no Riftwalk yet.

edits.before: By 2+ items his magic shield eats your empowered Q and Riftwalk blinks over your W to burst your squishy frame — he out-scales decisively.
edits.after: By 2+ items Riftwalk nears a 2s cooldown and blinks behind Aegis Assault, which only covers your front — he out-scales you decisively.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the weakest melee laners pre-6 and has no escape until Riftwalk, so this is your playground. Level 1 your point-and-click W stun plus an auto already out-damages anything he can do back. Bait or absorb his Q with your E block — that Q is his silence and his shield, so eating it on your channel denies him both. Then W-stun in, land an empowered Q, and walk away from a free trade while he can only farm.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the weakest melee laners pre-6 and has no escape until Riftwalk, so this is your playground. Level 1 your point-and-click Shield Vault stun plus an auto already out-damages anything he can do back. Null Sphere is not a silence — it is damage plus a shield on him — so face Aegis Assault at it and the poke does nothing while that shield goes to waste. Then Shield Vault in, empowered Comet Spear, and walk out of a free trade.

edits.before: Keep pressing — through levels 4-5 your empowered-Q poke and E blocks let you sit on him while he tries to scrape XP to 6. At 6 his Riftwalk gives him an escape, but it's a short blink with a stacking mana cost, so a clean W-stun still catches him mid-blink before he can chain it. Your own R is for roaming here: if he's farming safe, Grand Starfall to a sidelane or river gank and snowball the map rather than forcing a coinflip into his shield.
edits.after: Keep pressing — through 4-5 your empowered Comet Spear and Aegis Assault let you sit on him while he scrapes XP to 6. At 6 Riftwalk is only 500 range on a 5s cooldown with a stacking mana cost, so point-and-click Shield Vault still catches him mid-blink. Know your shield's limit: Aegis Assault is invulnerable from the front only, so a Riftwalk behind you wastes all 22 seconds of it — face it at him, not where he was. If he farms safe, Grand Starfall to a sidelane.

edits.before: This is where it slips away. Once Kassadin stacks Rod of Ages and picks up Lich Bane, his passive magic shield soaks your empowered Q and his Riftwalk lets him blink over your W-stun, reposition, and burst you down — and you have no sustain and a squishy frame to survive it. Your job is to make sure late never decides the game: cash your early lead into towers, roams, and an objective lead so your team closes before his Riftwalk-kiting takes over.
edits.after: This is where it slips away, but not for the reason the lane suggests: Void Stone only cuts magic damage and your spear is physical. Riftwalk is what beats you. Near a 2s cooldown with Rod of Ages and Lich Bane he blinks behind Aegis Assault, where your 22-second panic button covers nothing, then bursts a squishy frame with no sustain. Make late irrelevant — cash the early lead into towers, Grand Starfall roams and objectives before Riftwalk kiting takes over.

notes: Two fabricated effects removed. Null Sphere has no silence — Riot's text is damage, a channel interrupt, and a self-shield — yet the page called it 'his silence Q' and told you to block the silence. And Void Stone is magic damage reduction, not a shield; since Comet Spear and Shield Vault are physical it does nothing against your combo, so 'his magic shield eats your empowered Q' was wrong twice over. MIRROR REUSE: audits/top/kassadin__pantheon.json already established the decisive interaction from his side — Aegis Assault is invulnerable from the FRONT only, and Riftwalk's 500 range gets behind it. I stated the same fact from your side rather than re-deriving it, and left win[6] on Kassadin to match the mirror's flip of win[6] and phases[6].side. KIT-FILE CAVEAT: champ-data/_kits/kassadin.json tags Null Sphere with a 'channel' flag. Riot's description says Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels; it is not itself one. That is a tooltip-parsing misfire, and _missing-interactions.json has already built a mid-lane entry on it ("Kassadin's Null Sphere (Q) is a channel — your Shield Vault (W) cancels it outright") which should not ship. The converse — whether Null Sphere's interrupt cancels your Aegis Assault — is the highest-value unresolved line here; the mirror agent could not confirm it either, so it stays off both pages.
